errors.evidence: In the figure, series 2 is the light-blue line with open circles, but the description later claims it falls to about 8% by 2020; the plotted series actually ends around 8.5-9%. The main issue is that the description maps series 2 correctly by marker/color, so no error here.

errors.text_span: fällt dann auf etwa 13 % um 2015 und bleibt bis 2020 bei etwa 8 %
errors.evidence: The open-circle series (2) drops sharply around 2014-2015 to roughly 8.5-9%, but the description implies it is about 13% at 2015 and then about 8% through 2020. That 2015 value is too high and the late-series level is slightly low.
